runtime.fact_staleness_check: 15% subsample of practice: facts last seen from Sep 2026 on ~96% still current, Jun-Aug ~75%, earlier ~50% (confidence follows this)
runtime.note: extractor and classifier not merged yet: labels are the all-true baseline (0.83 confidence)

claim_capacity.hypothesis_1000_compare: feasible: 3,981 distinct compares, top 1,000 at confidence >= 0.93

claim_holdout.source: scripts/claim_holdout.py, practice pages hidden at random, 3 seeds, judged on all of practice
claim_holdout.hide_90pct_note: only ~220 rows kept, too few safe candidates: overall 9.2%, at_event 42% unconfirmed (rescheduled events), so at_event is capped at 0.6
claim_holdout.confidence_by_type: change 0.97-0.98; compare robust+recent 0.97, older dates 0.93, older amounts 0.90; fact 0.6-0.97 by recency; relation 0.70-0.75; at_event <= 0.6

after_same_attribute_compares.rule: compare only within one attribute; robust cross-attribute compares are a filler at 0.88 (unused on the full practice set)

consecutive_changes.note: change = consecutive steps only; on the full practice set 903 claims at >= 0.9, 97 timeline compares (dates of different attributes) at 0.885

claim_validator.fact_rule: a fact restates an input sentence only if that sentence names its subject and states its value; 296 fact candidates PASS, 99 distinct, 72 selected

text_restatement.rule: every input sentence, labelled or not: a sentence naming the subject within 80 characters of the value (any value-forms writing) restates the claim; farther apart = weak, fallback only
